question: Among the posts with a score of over 5, what is the percentage of them being owned by an elder user?
evidence: score of over 5 refers to Score > 5; elder user refers to Age > 65; percentage = Divide (Count(Id where Age>65), Count(Id)) * 100
clarification: Also keep rows that have no matching users record.
gold: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(T2.Age > 65, 1, 0)) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.Id) FROM posts AS T1 LEFT JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.OwnerUserId = T2.Id WHERE T1.Score > 5
gold0: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(T2.Age > 65, 1, 0)) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.Id) FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.OwnerUserId = T2.Id WHERE T1.Score > 5

d.request: Among posts with a score greater than 5, what percentage are owned by users older than 65? Include posts with no matching user record in the total count.
d.sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN u.Age > 65 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS percentage FROM posts AS p LEFT JOIN users AS u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id WHERE p.Score > 5;

c.request:
Among the posts with a score of over 5, what is the percentage of them being owned by an elder user?
Evidence: score of over 5 refers to Score > 5; elder user refers to Age > 65; percentage = Divide (Count(Id where Age>65), Count(Id)) * 100
Also keep rows that have no matching users record.
c.sql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN u.Age > 65 THEN p.Id END) / COUNT(p.Id) AS percentage FROM posts AS p LEFT JOIN users AS u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id WHERE p.Score > 5;

b.request: What percentage of all posts with Score > 5, including posts with no matching owner in users, are owned by a user whose Age > 65?
b.sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN u.Age > 65 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS percentage FROM posts AS p LEFT JOIN users AS u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id WHERE p.Score > 5;
